decisions.label: free_plan_limit
decisions.title: Free plan capped at 5 projects
decisions.body:
# Free plan capped at 5 projects

The free tier allows a maximum of 5 projects per user. This value is defined as FREE_PLAN_LIMIT in billing.ts, referenced in PRICING.md, settings.json (freePlanLimit), and the welcome email. All must stay in sync. NOTE: billing.ts currently has FREE_PLAN_LIMIT = 10 which CONTRADICTS the docs — this is intentional drift to demonstrate Reponoesis detection.

decisions.label: pro_plan_price
decisions.title: Use pro plan price
decisions.body: The Pro plan costs /month. Defined as PRO_PLAN_PRICE in billing.ts. Must stay consistent across PRICING.md, settings.json, welcome_email, and store listing.
